note: frame_match cosines recorded off two masters, ids scrubbed. `last_vs_cell`: each shot's last sampled frame against its own storyboard panel -- `on` is a master on its board (every shot over ON_BOARD .50), `off` is the one bad episode's class (three of four shots under, the worst at .075). `pairs`: representative-frame pairs over REPEAT .90 with whether one setup explains them; a pair two setups share is a repeat, a pair inside one setup is the same room drawn twice and is not.
